rv.q: For Raven to pull off the Midwestern premiere of this fiendishly difficult piece at this extraordinarily high level is nothing short of remarkable.
I encourage all musical theater lovers to put down their phones for 90 minutes and appreciate the simultaneous creativity, wonder, humor, and sadness of Octet.

Still, the show presents compelling short stories, with creative music that does conjure that a cappella magic of being in the space where chords and melodies emerge from nothing more than living, breathing human bodies.
And this utterly fascinating, superbly electrifying, totally mesmerizing musical is guaranteed to rock you to your very core.
Dave Malloy’s brilliant chamber musical turns doomscrolling, loneliness, and internet addiction into something unexpectedly humane.
Their production captures everything that makes the musical so singular: its humor, its humanity, its discomfort, and its breathtaking musicality.
Raven Theatre’s Octet is lean and electrifying, a miraculous theatrical feat.
With "Octet," Raven has delivered a dazzling show—one that also delivers us.
This is a stunning musical odyssey, richly performed and perhaps the finest ensemble performance of the year.
Octet now stands among the most original musicals of the last decade.
Dave Malloy’s genius musical digital cautionary tale is beautifully performed, beautifully directed, beautifully staged.
A perfect blend of voices to make this a special theatrical event.
Octet is a theatrical experience that must be witnessed in person to fully feel its energy and wonder.

cn.t: Critics hail Dave Malloy's a cappella chamber musical as a stunning, wholly original work that defies expectations. The virtuosic vocal performances, inventive staging, and timely exploration of internet addiction create an emotionally resonant theatrical experience.
